records.japanese: フフ、お姉さまがいいこと教えてあげる。　<line-break>探索クエストの目的物には<line-break>危険な副次効果を持つものがあるのよ。<line-break>例えば、ノロガメは<line-break>持ってると呪いがかかってしまうとか、ね。<line-break>気をつけないとひどい目に遭うわよ。<end>

records.japanese: <select><value:$33>無事に荷が届いて、ほっとひと安心だのう。<line-break>わしは気が弱いから、<line-break>無事に荷が届くまで心配で心配で…。<end>無事に荷が届いて、ほっとひと安心だのう。<line-break>わしは気が弱いから、<line-break>無事に荷が届くまで心配で心配で…。<end>アンティノ様の命令で戦闘用モンスターや<line-break>武器をロセンに送るときは心が痛むのだよ。<line-break>わしもペウダ王の非道は知っておるのでのう。<end>ロセンが解放されて、今度は復興のために<line-break>必要な物資を送ることになったのだ。<line-break>これで少しはよいことをした気になれるのう。<end>ロセンはどんどん復興して立派になっておる。<line-break>わしも仕事のしがいがあるのだけれど、<line-break>解放軍に狙われるのはイヤだのう。<end>いつの時代でも権力者に従わなかった<line-break>自由都市リベルダムが、アンティノの裏切りで<line-break>めちゃくちゃになってしもうた…ぐすっ。<end>フゴー殿がここを捨ててロセンに引っ越して<line-break>しまったので、もうここの復興は無理だのう。<line-break>わしはどうするかのう…。<end>今ではロセンが大陸一の商業都市で<line-break>リベルダム名物の闘技場も移ってしもうた。<line-break>もう、ここには何もないんじゃ…。<end>
records.english: <select><value:$33>What a relief to see the cargo arrive safely. I'm a timid sort, so I worry and worry until I know it's safe...<end>What a relief to see the cargo arrive safely. I'm a timid sort, so I worry and worry until I know it's safe...<end>It pains me whenever Lord Antino orders me to send combat monsters and weapons to Rocen. I know how cruel King Peuda is.<end>Now that Rocen has been liberated, we're sending the supplies needed to rebuild it. At least now I can feel I've done a little good.<end>Rocen is growing grander by the day as the rebuilding continues. It makes the work worthwhile, but I don't much like being targeted by the Liberation Army.<end>The Free City Liberdam never bowed to those in power, in any age. Now Antino's betrayal has left it in ruins... Sniff.<end>Lord Hugo abandoned this place and moved to Rocen, so there's no hope of rebuilding here now. What am I going to do...?<end>Rocen is now the foremost commercial city on the continent, and even Liberdam's famous arena has moved there. There's nothing left here now...<end>
records.reason: Pinned English keeps 心が痛む/知っておる as current-state facts ('It pains me... I know...'), while Korean had shifted both to past. It also reads 復興して立派 as ongoing rebuilding that makes Rocen grander, 狙われる as being targeted, and もうここの復興は無理 as no hope of rebuilding—not merely 'difficult'. Restore those meanings in natural Korean, add the missing 의 in 안티노 님의 명령, and remove unnecessary causal commas.
